what: Speed of the same model loaded in the stored precision (float16, what transformers 5.5 does by default) and in float32, on this laptop's CPU (Intel Core Ultra 7 155H, 16 threads, no GPU). Measured once, on a machine that also ran other programs, so read the ratio, not the absolute numbers.

DeBERTa-v3-large-mnli-fever-anli-ling-wa.note: 16 identical short pairs; a speed test only, not an accuracy test
